# Quickstart: Copy-SpecKit.ps1

<!-- Generated by Spec-Kit /speckit.plan | Session: 8eb724b4-5309-47ce-817f-68e0bf6b32fa | Date: 2026-01-27 -->

## Prerequisites

- PowerShell 7.0+ (`pwsh`)
- Pester 5.x (for running tests only): `Install-Module Pester -MinimumVersion 5.0 -Scope CurrentUser`

## Script Location

```
.specify/scripts/powershell/Copy-SpecKit.ps1
```

## Quick Usage

### 1. Scaffold a new project

```powershell
# From the Spec-Kit source repository
.\.specify\scripts\powershell\Copy-SpecKit.ps1 -Destination C:\Projects\MyNewProject
```

### 2. Preview before copying

```powershell
.\.specify\scripts\powershell\Copy-SpecKit.ps1 -Destination C:\Projects\MyNewProject -Preview
```

### 3. Include domain-specific agents

```powershell
.\.specify\scripts\powershell\Copy-SpecKit.ps1 -Destination C:\Projects\MyProject -IncludeDomains umbraco
```

### 4. Update an existing project

```powershell
.\.specify\scripts\powershell\Copy-SpecKit.ps1 -Destination C:\Projects\ExistingProject -Force
```

## Running Tests

```powershell
# Run all tests
Invoke-Pester .\.specify\scripts\powershell\Copy-SpecKit.tests.ps1

# Run with verbose output
Invoke-Pester .\.specify\scripts\powershell\Copy-SpecKit.tests.ps1 -Output Detailed
```

## Post-Copy Steps

After running the script, follow the checklist printed in the output:

1. Create `CLAUDE.project.md` with your project's technology conventions
2. Run `/speckit.constitution` to establish project governance
3. Review `.claude/settings.json` and adjust for your project
4. Create `.claude/settings.local.json` for local environment overrides
5. Review `.claude/hooks.json` and adjust build/test commands
6. Start with `/speckit.specify` to define your first feature

## Implementation Notes

- The script is a single PowerShell file with no external module dependencies
- Tests use Pester 5 with `TestDrive:\` for filesystem isolation
- All paths are handled cross-platform via `Join-Path`
- Domain modules are auto-discovered from filename prefixes in `.claude/agents/`
